title: Desktop dynamic-view resource scope
red: DesktopDynamicResourceScopeContractTests failed before implementation because DashboardView and ProtectionView still used direct UserControl FindResource calls.
implementation: DashboardView and ProtectionView now resolve their dynamic Card, MutedText, and Ghost styles through Application.Current.FindResource, preventing early-render resource lookup failures before the controls are attached to the window tree.
boundary: No authenticated visual browser/published-EXE smoke claim; Authenticode signing, hosted CodeQL/SARIF, external penetration testing, load/SLO, SIEM, and production certification remain outside this verification run.
